name: Jr. Lifeguard Academy (StarGuard Junior Lifeguard)
org: Livermore Area Recreation and Park District
what_you_do: You learn basic water lifesaving and first aid in a four day summer class. You take part in guided challenges and activities at the pool.
who_can_apply: Ages 11 to 14. You do not need lifesaving or first aid skills. The program page asks you to be comfortable in the water and have basic swim skills.
pay_detail: $100 for Livermore residents and $120 for non-residents.
deadline_text: The program page lists three June sessions: June 1 to 4, June 15 to 18 and June 29 to July 2. It does not give a year, and next summer is not posted.
how_to_apply: Pick a session on the program page. Use the register link for that session. The page does not give sign up dates.
notes: Sessions run Monday to Thursday, 1 to 4 p.m. This is a class, not a job. The program page footer says 2026, and the course numbers end in 26. It does not state the camp year. Phone 925-373-5700.
